 I thought this was exactly the right season to come by. But seeing the customer ahead of me, I wonder if I've shown up a little early.

 I don't know what you want to do with those scissors...

dataList.content:

 But you've got that desire in you... enough that I can see you coming back to have me severed someday.

dataList.title:
改衣室

dataList.content:
等那天到来时，你知道该找谁做改衣服务。
 When that day comes, you know whose alteration services to go with.

 The customer nods along as Miss Alterationist speaks. Then, with his business apparently concluded, he turns and walks in my direction.

他看见我时，惊讶得张大了嘴……随即歪着头，像是在数着什么。
 When he sees me, his mouth falls open in apparent surprise... Then he tilts his head, like he's counting something.

我试着回想他是谁。我们以前见过吗？可我怎么都想不起在百货公司哪里见过这种款式的衣服。
 I try to place him. Did we meet somewhere before? But I can't recall ever seeing that style of clothing anywhere in the department store.

dataList.title:
褐派
 Le Kaki
dataList.content:
杜布瓦：哦……呃，你好。很高兴认识你……
 Oh... uh, hello. Nice to meet you...

这是个笨拙的打招呼方式，但我想着或许能借此打破僵局……
 It was a clumsy attempt at a greeting, but I thought it might help break the ice...

但他低声笑了——更像是嗤笑——像是想通了什么。不管想通了什么，他都没说出口，一言不发地转身离开了。
 But he chuckled—scoffed, really—under his breath, as though he'd just worked something out. Whatever it was, he kept it to himself and left without a word.

dataList.title:
改衣室

dataList.content:

 The sunshine feels lovely, I know, but don't go basking in it all day. You don't want to end up like those Mannequins shambling around the shops.

dataList.content:

 Haha... I just wasn't expecting to see a Rouge customer at your shop. I didn't think they'd have dealings with you, Miss Alterationist.

dataList.title:
改衣室
 Alteration Shop
dataList.content:
谁来找布料，我都欢迎。
 Anyone who comes looking for fabric is welcome here.

dataList.title:

dataList.content:

 That's why I keep ignoring the Noirs when they ask me to run a shop for them. And believe me, they don't tire of asking.

dataList.title:

dataList.content:

 Yours is all ready to go. Give me a moment to put the finishing touches on this other one. Won't be much longer.

dataList.title:
改衣室
 Alteration Shop
dataList.content:
这么纯粹、高贵的材料，必须悉心对待……可不是那种能放下再捡起来接着做的活儿。
 You have to treat such pure, noble material with care... It's not the sort of work you can just put down to pick up again later.

搭在她膝上的那块布料散发着我从未见过的光泽。这段时间我看过不少布料，但从没见过那样的颜色。
 The fabric resting in her lap had a radiance I'd never seen before. I'd looked at plenty of fabrics by now, but nothing with a color quite like that.

我看过的大多数布料，都得仔细端详才能大致判断出各种材质的含量……可这一块？光凭眼睛就能看出它的纯度极高。
 Most fabrics I've seen so far had to be scrutinized to get an idea of how much of each material was in them... But this one? I could tell it's high-purity just by looking.

买那样一块布料得花多少眼球啊……？我根本没法想象那价钱。
 How many eyeballs would it take to buy fabric like that...? I couldn't even begin to put a price on it.

也许要在1楼捡上几百个季度的眼球……不，我骗谁呢？就算那样也够不着。
 Maybe if I spent hundreds of seasons picking up eyeballs on 1F... No, who am I kidding? Even that wouldn't put it within reach.

dataList.content:

 Golden Fabric for their armor... something suitably "righteous" and "exalted". That was the request.
